name: Watarai (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Watarai town emblem in white: a stylised angular device with a ring, like a bird.
history: Municipal flag of Watarai, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in March 1960.

features.role: Watarai town emblem — a stylised angular device with a ring, like a bird
